scope: Read-only inspection of current archive implementation and actual cleanup receipt fields; archive execution and byte verification are separate root-owned steps.

findings.evidence: Only postwork_awake_01 may use process_exit_observation when release.json is missing. Exact status, acquired PID, acquire-byte SHA256, observed absence, empty matching command list and explicit_api_clear_verified=false are required. Original experimental helper still requires released status, matching PID and integer clear_flags=2147483648.

The manifest records postwork absence status and explicit_api_clear_verified=false separately from the experimental helper explicit_release_verified. It does not assert the postwork exit cause or successful explicit API clearing.

Run/design/main-candidate/recovery roots plus top-level helpers/tests/PDF and PNG evidence are contained in the workspace and nonempty at archive execution. File roots already covered by an existing root are skipped; duplicate inventory paths reject.

Frozen source hashes are checked. All input paths have initial size/mtime_ns checked immediately before and after reads, followed by full inventory comparison after ZIP close. Source files are only read; no deletion or restore writes are invoked.

ZIP, manifest and verification outputs live outside evidence roots, reject existing outputs, and use exclusive creation. restore(...,write=False) validates ZIP SHA256, entry coverage, path safety and member bytes without restoring. Partial failure may leave an incomplete exclusive output but no successful verification claim.

Archive preserves old interrupted and new terminal pilot, prospective main candidate, code and review records. Main PDFs and reviewed PNG pages are included. Missing/failed stages stay unchanged, model_calls=0, and completion_is_not_semantic_or_research_success=true.

axes.errors: No blocking defect found in inspected current fallback or receipt field/types. Missing postwork explicit release is an observed limitation, not repaired with fabricated evidence.
axes.consistency: Current archive SHA and real receipt hashes are bound; original experimental clear and postwork process absence remain distinct. Exclusive output and stable inventory checks preserve provenance.
axes.paper_topic: Packaging preserves the allocation/citation experiment and candidate source evidence without adding inference, changing treatment inputs, excluding failed slots or asserting scientific validity.

limitations: Static review did not execute archive(), syntax compilation, unit tests, restoration or ZIP verification.
Postwork helper absence was observed at 23:44:14.4973348Z and 23:44:16.2471402Z. Exact exit time, exit cause and explicit API clear remain unknown.
Source stability verification depends on the archive helper executing after all writers are quiet; actual byte verification remains a separate result.
